svg.aria-label: Dumbbell curl, Setup: Stand tall with the dumbbell at your side, arm long and palm facing your thigh.
svg.title: Dumbbell curl, Setup: Stand tall with the dumbbell at your side, arm long and palm facing your thigh.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell curl, Lift: Curl it up with your elbow pinned to your side, turning your palm up as you lift.
svg.title: Dumbbell curl, Lift: Curl it up with your elbow pinned to your side, turning your palm up as you lift.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell curl, Top: Squeeze at the top with your palm up and wrist straight. Your elbow stays at your side.
svg.title: Dumbbell curl, Top: Squeeze at the top with your palm up and wrist straight. Your elbow stays at your side.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell curl, Lower: Lower it slowly, turning your palm back towards your thigh, all the way to a long arm.
svg.title: Dumbbell curl, Lower: Lower it slowly, turning your palm back towards your thigh, all the way to a long arm.
